structured_output.summary: The change delegates to the existing shared `get_view_value` helper with `ElementType::Float64`. It passes `this`, `byteOffset` (arg 0) and `littleEndian` (arg 1, undefined if absent). It propagates the result with no error handling of its own. Treating an absent `littleEndian` as `undefined` is equivalent to spec step 2, because GetViewValue applies ToBoolean and `ToBoolean(undefined)` is false. The diff touches only the in-scope file. The target went from 6 to 42 passing with 0 regressions. I did not see the helper's source, so I could not check GetViewValue steps 1–13 directly. The passing test262 results are the evidence that the helper follows them.
